scope: all author-archived Carlisle2005 maximum-outline polygons intersecting fixed Kabir5m grid; existing five polygons and all263 marks preserved
observational_units: whole 5m cell footprints fully covered by the reported event-maximum outline union; partially intersected cells separately boundary-ambiguous; outside outline is unknown, NOT dry
classification_indicator: maximum simulated depth >0.1m following archived round68 extent.py analysis indicator; additional 0.01m and0.3m classifications reported as fixed sensitivity, not selected for score
limits: 0.1m is an analysis indicator, not personal/vehicle safety
outline precision has no calibrated uncertainty bound; edge ambiguity is geometric only
source polygons may contain permanent channels; does not prove newly flooded dry land
no known-dry evidence, so cannot infer false alarms, overall accuracy, IoU or verified route accessibility
no observed arrival/recession maps here; maximum map only
other qualitative requirements remain unverified, cannot be deleted for pass
pass_rule: report every pre-registered fully covered cell as supported or missed using fixed main indicator; any miss prevents all-consistent result; boundary and external unknowns preserved, not in correct-count
